how_to_read_results: leader_count is only the length of a JSON list from grok leader list --json, and only after that command's own --help prints --json. The vendor CLI reference retrieved with these docs does not document the subcommand. An empty list means this output discovered no leader. It does not mean attachment is impossible, and a non-empty list does not mean a prompt may be sent. pinned_session_id_seen is a boolean substring check. Summaries are discarded. Neither observation makes disk load into live attachment, and neither proves the turn is idle.

user_env.AGENT_SESSION_CWD: Absolute workspace directory of that session. Refused when a path segment is .grok. If unset or unsafe, session presence stays unknown.
user_env.PINNED_SESSION_ID: Exact session id. If unset, sessions list is skipped.

skipped: any read of ~/.grok/sessions or auth files
when_a_coordinated_restart_would_be_requ: If a future design needs peerb restarted, use_leader flipped, or a new agent process, that is a coordinated change. This preflight does not do it, and a restart would still not supply the missing semantics.
when_a_live_test_could_proceed: Only after a vendor document states all of: a second client attaches to the same running in-memory session; a prompt is queued behind an active human turn and cannot steer or cancel it; the TUI draft buffer is left untouched; and a speaker identity other than the user prompt exists. A new build would still have to enable the transport. Leader presence and a visible session id are not sufficient.
